chunks: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Ibn Abi 'Umayr, from Hanan ibn Sudayr, who said:
I heard a man ask Aba 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, and he said: “At times I urinate and cannot access water, and that becomes difficult for me.”
So he عليه السلام said: “When you urinate and wipe yourself, then wipe your male organ with your saliva. Then if you find something, say: this is from that.”

key_terms.هَذَا مِنْ ذَاكَ: this is from that; an attribution of the later trace to the earlier moisture

ai.seo_question: What should a person do if he urinates and cannot access water, then later notices some moisture?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses a ruling related to ritual purity after urination when water is not readily available. Imam Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام instructs a practical measure to deal with lingering doubt or moisture, indicating how such traces are to be understood in this context.
